v1.35 MediaMTX v1.21.0 上游来源证明 / Upstream artifact attestation
===========================================================

Project version: v1.35. Commands, paths and verification values below are shared
by both languages. Dated validation records are preserved from that verification;
this documentation review does not claim a new runtime test or attestation run.

Verification date:
  2026-09-12

Official release:
  https://github.com/bluenviron/mediamtx/releases/tag/v1.21.0

Verified source and signing identity:
  repository: bluenviron/mediamtx
  source commit: 2c6727904fbf233615de74a6c54a9b94dbf6025d
  source ref: refs/tags/v1.21.0
  signer workflow: bluenviron/mediamtx/.github/workflows/release.yml
  certificate SAN:
    https://github.com/bluenviron/mediamtx/.github/workflows/release.yml@refs/tags/v1.21.0
  certificate issuer: CN=sigstore-intermediate,O=sigstore.dev
  OIDC issuer: https://token.actions.githubusercontent.com
  runner environment: github-hosted
  predicate type: https://slsa.dev/provenance/v1
  release invocation:
    https://github.com/bluenviron/mediamtx/actions/runs/33992881325/attempts/1

Verified transparency-log evidence, identical for both artifacts:
  type: Tlog
  URI: https://rekor.sigstore.dev
  verified timestamp: 2026-09-06T05:28:38+08:00
  equivalent UTC timestamp: 2026-09-05T21:28:38Z
  bundle integratedTime: 1788643718

Verified official release subjects (archive SHA-256):
  mediamtx_v1.21.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz
    e02e34c3337a35f20ac9e5aa31524566108964e6e37dbc46cf8292169f6c792b
  mediamtx_v1.21.0_linux_arm64.tar.gz
    a8113b5928ba1a934b81557b61b8a07954b76921a4b567d54c7f086f8b39d9a2

Verification procedure and result:
  GitHub CLI 2.100.0 (2026-09-03) verified each official archive against its
  downloaded Sigstore bundle. Both invocations returned 0. The checks required
  repository bluenviron/mediamtx, the exact source digest and source ref above,
  the release signer workflow, SLSA provenance and --deny-self-hosted-runners.
  Verified certificate fields, statement subjects and verifiedTimestamps were
  checked from each JSON result; the statement resolves the source dependency
  to the exact v1.21.0 commit. Downloaded archive hashes also matched the
  official GitHub release metadata digests.

  Before use, the GitHub CLI Linux amd64 distribution was checked against its
  recorded published SHA-256:
    e4d4bb4498e8d007abe545b6568926793ace1b6447da598294a610018cb164be

  The accompanying upgrade evidence includes attest-inputs.log,
  attestation-result.txt, attestation-amd64.json and attestation-arm64.json.
  These records verify the exact v1.21.0 artifacts on the date stated above.

Patched dependency identity:
  repository: https://github.com/bluenviron/gortmplib.git
  source commit: fbafd129baf54d49a2e3243f620d738ed72ff82e
  source ref: refs/tags/v1.0.2
  Its source tag was resolved and its compatibility patch checked separately.
  The MediaMTX artifact attestation is not a separate gortmplib attestation.

Scope of custom builds:
  The project builds v1.21.0-r11 from the verified MediaMTX source commit using
  Go 1.27.1, the patches in BUILDING.md, the exact MediaMTX-go.mod/go.sum graph
  and a sibling patched gortmplib v1.0.2. Its embedded HLS library is v1.7.3.
  The upstream attestation covers the official release archives above; it does
  not certify the patched project binaries. Both custom architectures were
  separately rebuilt with a fresh GOCACHE and matched byte-for-byte. Their
  hashes and test/scan results are in MediaMTX-AOM-AV1-PATCH.txt, BUILDING.md
  and the package SHA256SUMS.

中文说明（与上文共用完整身份字段、地址和校验值）
================================================

验证对象与日期：
  本项目版本为 v1.35。本记录的对象是官方 MediaMTX v1.21.0 发行包，验证日期为
  2026-09-12；本次文档整理不表示重新签发来源证明或再次执行该验证。

验证的源码与签名身份：
  repository 为 bluenviron/mediamtx；source commit/ref 分别是上文固定提交和
  refs/tags/v1.21.0；signer workflow 为该仓库的 .github/workflows/release.yml。
  certificate SAN、证书颁发者、GitHub Actions OIDC 颁发者、github-hosted
  runner 环境、SLSA provenance predicate 和准确 release invocation 地址均见
  上文，验证时逐项限制并检查，不能以任意仓库或任意工作流的有效签名替代。

透明日志与主体：
  两个发行包的证据均为 https://rekor.sigstore.dev 的 Tlog，已验证时间戳
  2026-09-06T05:28:38+08:00 等同于 2026-09-05T21:28:38Z，bundle 的
  integratedTime 为 1788643718。上文分别列出官方 amd64/arm64 归档的准确
  文件名和 SHA-256；这些不是本项目定制二进制的哈希。

过程与结果：
  GitHub CLI 2.100.0（2026-09-03）使用下载的 Sigstore bundle 核验每个官方
  归档，两次命令均返回 0。验证要求准确仓库、源码 digest/ref、发行签名工作流、
  SLSA provenance，并启用 --deny-self-hosted-runners。逐项读取 JSON 的已验证
  证书字段、statement subjects 和 verifiedTimestamps；statement 的源码依赖
  解析到准确的 v1.21.0 提交。下载包哈希同时匹配官方 GitHub 发行元数据 digest。
  使用 GitHub CLI 前，已核验其 Linux amd64 发行包与上文记录的官方 SHA-256
  一致。证据文件包括 attest-inputs.log、attestation-result.txt、
  attestation-amd64.json 和 attestation-arm64.json；它们对应上述日期和准确对象。

修补依赖身份：
  gortmplib 仓库、固定提交和 refs/tags/v1.0.2 见上文。其源码标签解析和兼容补丁
  单独核验；MediaMTX 归档来源证明不等于另行取得了 gortmplib 来源证明。

定制构建范围：
  项目以已核验的 MediaMTX 提交、Go 1.27.1、BUILDING.md 中的补丁、准确的
  MediaMTX-go.mod/go.sum 和同级修补版 gortmplib v1.0.2 构建 v1.21.0-r11，
  内嵌 hls.js 为 v1.7.3。上游证明只覆盖所列官方归档，不认证定制二进制。
  两种定制架构另以全新 GOCACHE 重建，逐字节一致；哈希和测试/扫描结果见
  MediaMTX-AOM-AV1-PATCH.txt、BUILDING.md 及发行包 SHA256SUMS。
